logic.note: ST7735 command set as Adafruit_ST7735 uses it (initR black tab): SWRESET, SLPOUT, COLMOD 16/18-bit, MADCTL (MY, MX, MV, RGB/BGR), CASET/RASET windows with wrap, RAMWR, INVON/INVOFF, DISPON/DISPOFF. Frame-rate, power and gamma commands are accepted and ignored. The panel is the 128x160 black-tab glass with no column/row offset.

timing.note: Bytes arrive at the emulated SPI speed, so redraw times are realistic; the panel shows each pixel immediately (no refresh, no tearing).

analog.note: RGB565 expanded linearly to 8 bits per channel, no gamma or viewing angle.

power.note: About 20 mA logic plus 30 mA backlight from VCC; losing VCC clears RAM.

doesNotEmulate: Green-tab and red-tab panels' column/row offsets (initR(INITR_GREENTAB) draws shifted on real hardware)
testOnRealDevice: Which tab your module has (black, green, red): the wrong initR option shifts the image or swaps colours
